title: Website brought up to date
body: As of 17 July 2026, the SMI Lab homepage is up to date, fully operational, and filled with all necessary information.

title: Editorial board appointment — International Journal of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering
body: Professor Jae Hoon Seo has been appointed an Editorial Board Member of the International Journal of Naval Architecture and Ocean Engineering for the term July 2026 to July 2028. The journal ranks 5th of 25 in the Engineering, Marine category.

title: Teacher's Day 2026
body: The lab celebrated Teacher's Day for the first time.

title: Hui Won Lee joins the lab
body: Hui Won Lee joins as the lab's sixth member, a 3rd-year student interested in structural design.

title: Jun Hyeok Hwang joins the lab
body: Jun Hyeok Hwang joins as the lab's fifth member, a 3rd-year student interested in ship and offshore structural mechanics.

title: Woojin Lee joins the lab
body: Woojin Lee joins as the lab's fourth member, a 3rd-year student interested in alternative fuel storage systems.

title: ISSC Specialist Committee V.4 appointment
body: Professor Seo has been appointed to Specialist Committee V.4 — Offshore Renewable Energy of the International Ship and Offshore Structures Congress, recognising expertise in offshore renewable energy systems and structural integrity.

title: Jinwoo Song joins the lab
body: Jinwoo Song joins as the lab's third member, a 3rd-year student interested in offshore structural mechanics.

title: Kyusung Shim joins the lab
body: Kyusung Shim joins as the lab's second member, a 3rd-year student interested in naval ship structures.

title: Guest editor — Data-Driven Methods for Marine Structures, Second Edition
body: Professor Seo serves as Guest Editor for this Journal of Marine Science and Engineering special issue. Submission deadline: 10 January 2026.

title: Guest editor — New Advances in the Analysis and Design of Marine Structures
body: Professor Seo serves as Guest Editor for this Journal of Marine Science and Engineering special issue, focusing on renewable energy applications and structural integrity. Submission deadline: 30 November 2025.

title: Jun Soo Lim joins the lab
body: Jun Soo Lim joins as the lab's first member, a 2nd-year student demonstrating a willingness to learn new skills.

title: ISSC 2025, Wuxi
body: Professor Seo attended the 22nd International Ship and Offshore Structures Congress as an Observer representing the Republic of Korea, held in Wuxi, China.

title: MADEX 2025 naval seminar
body: Professor Seo chaired the Naval Vessel Integrated Survivability / Damage Control / Special Performance session at MADEX 2025 in Busan.

title: Inha University interview
body: An interview published on the Inha University homepage discussing Professor Seo's personal story and future contributions to the community.

title: KSOE 2025 spring meeting
body: Professor Seo presented "Development of a Machine Learning Model for Real-Time Monitoring of FOWT Mooring Systems" at the Korean Society of Ocean Engineers meeting in Busan.

title: Arirang TV interview
body: Professor Seo was interviewed regarding US Navy Secretary John Phelan's visit to Korean shipyards, commenting on strategic shipbuilding cooperation between South Korea and the USA.

title: SNAK greeting
body: Professor Seo's greeting as a new faculty member was published in the March 2025 issue of SNAKZINE.

title: Lab established
body: The Marine Structural Mechanics and Integrity Lab was established as Professor Jae Hoon Seo joined Inha University.
